title: Critic review of one agent's recent outputs

summary.description: Two or three sentences: how good is this batch, and the main thing to fix.

evidence.description: What in the output shows it (quote a field, a URL you checked).

suggestion.description: What the agent should do differently next time.

keep.description: What works and must not be lost when the prompt changes.

promptChanges.description: Concrete instruction changes, one per entry.
